name: Axes
description: Just axes for charts

name: Bar
description: A bar for bar chart

name: BarChart
description: Bar chart that can be used as a content to axes .

name: BarSet
description: A group of bars for bar chart

name: LegendItem
description: A button for a legend of ring or pie charts

name: LineDaysChart
description: Line chart but for days

name: Amount
description: Pipe to format number values to show money sums Number formatting can be customized by using TUI_NUMBER_FORMAT

name: Currency
description: Pipe for transforming number into money. It is usually used with `InputNumber`

name: InputCard
description: `InputCard` can be used with `InputExpire` and `InputCVC` to input a card. Use `tuiCreateLuhnValidator(message)` to create a `Validator` that uses Luhn algorithm

name: InputCardGroup
description: `InputCardGroup` is used to input a card as a separated control

name: ThumbnailCard
description: Customizable credit card thumbnail

name: BottomSheet
description: A non-modal draggable sheet

name: ElasticSticky
description: Directive allows to scale "stuck" sticky heading. It can also be used as service `TuiElasticStickyService`

name: KeyboardService
description: A service that allows hiding and showing virtual keyboard programmatically on both Android and iOS devices Does nothing on devices with no virtual keyboard or when input is not focused

name: Keypad
description: `TuiKeypad` is an on-screen grid primitive for touch input. It only lays out and styles the keys — you project your own native `<button>` or `<a>` elements and wire clicks, labels and disabled state yourself, so the pad can be anything: a numeric pad, a shuffled PIN terminal, a calculator or a custom chooser. Each key stays a real element, so `(click)` , `aria-label` , `disabled` and `href` all work as usual. Each key updates your own state on `(click)` — display the running value however you like (the examples keep it in a signal shown in a `<div>` ).

name: MobileCalendar
description: A calendar for mobile devices. It is used in date picker controls on mobile devices if `tuiMobileCalendar` directive is applied. You can use `TUI_CALENDAR_DATE_STREAM` token to set value from outside (see samples)

name: PullToRefresh
description: Component to refresh content after pull top. It emulates appearance of native iOS and Android components It emits `(pulled)` event when the pull threshold is reached. You can set that threshold in pixels by `TUI_PULL_TO_REFRESH_THRESHOLD` DI token. You can finish loading with `TUI_PULL_TO_REFRESH_LOADED` stream token that can be provided in DI. While the scroll container is scrolled to the top, the component automatically applies `overscroll-behavior: none;` to it so elastic scrolling on iOS does not interfere with pulling. Once scrolled away from the top, the property is removed and the native bounce works as usual

name: Ripple
description: Directive for «ripple» effect on mobile devices

name: SearchBar
description: `TuiSearchBar` is a mobile search field. Put `tuiSearchBar` on any element — semantically that is `<search>` — project a native `<input tuiSearchBar>` into it and a `<button tuiButtonX>` next to it. The searchbar only lays them out per platform: on iOS the button sits to the right of the field, on Android it moves inside the field on the leading side and turns into a back arrow.

name: SheetDialog
description: A mobile draggable sheet dialog

name: SwipeActions
description: Component should be used on mobile devices only.

name: TabBar
description: Component for creating mobile navigation.

name: Touchable
description: Directive to emulate native iOS touches

name: Reorder
description: Component to change order of elements in an array

name: Table
description: This module allows you to create various tables, both static and editable.

name: TableFilters
description: This module allows you to filter table data in a flexible way.

name: TablePagination
description: Component to show pagination in table footer

name: ActiveZone
description: `tuiActiveZone` allows to track a scope that user interacts with. For example, for closing dropdown on blur

name: Animated
description: `TuiAnimated` allows adding animation to DOM elements in the same way as Angular's animate attribute but supported in Angular 19. In case the user's operating system has reduced motion settings turned on, Taiga UI will honor this, disabling animations under its control, and `TuiAnimated` will not play animations. To override this behavior, use `TUI_REDUCED_MOTION` injection token. However, this is not the recommended approach, as the user's system preferences would be ignored.

name: AutoFocus
description: `tuiAutoFocus` allows to focus HTML-element right after its appearance. It works also with focusable Taiga UI components

name: CopyProcessor
description: Directive is used to processed text when coping

name: Element
description: Directive is used to get a link to a native element as template reference variable (analogue of `@ViewChild('ref', {read: ElementRef}` for template)

name: Filter
description: Pipe for filtering an array

name: HoveredChange
description: `tuiHoveredChange` is used for emitting true/false when users hovers over an element or moves cursor away from it.

name: Mapper
description: Pipe to transform a value with a function

name: Media
description: Directive for declarative work with HTML5 video and audio

name: Obfuscate
description: Pipe for obfuscating sensitive data

name: Pan
description: `tuiPan` The directive emits delta between mousemove / touchmove events. You can use it to change the coordinates of an element as in example below

name: Resizer
description: Directive to resize container in multiple directions.

name: Swipe
description: `tuiSwipe` directive allows detecting swipes on mobile devices. You can configure the directive with `TUI_SWIPE_OPTIONS` token. Allowed options: timeout: max time between touchstart and touchend threshold : min distance between touchstart and touchend.

name: Truncate
description: Truncates text with an ellipsis in the middle. Useful when both start and end of the string are relevant, such as long file names with extension.

name: Validator
description: `tuiValidator` allows set validators for form control on the fly

name: ValueChanges
description: This directive allows you to access reactive control or container value changes as an output

name: Zoom
description: `tuiZoom` directive emits delta between wheel events or between pinch on mobile devices. It emits coordinates of the zoom center as well. You can use it to change the scale of an element as in example below

name: Viewport
description: `TUI_VIEWPORT` - define the area relative to which the position constraints will be calculated. Also you can use `tuiAsViewport` helper instead of token.

name: Appearance
description: A directive for visual presets of interactive components

name: Button
description: Button is a basic component used for both icon buttons and regular buttons with optional icons on either side. It can be applied to `button` , `a` and `label` tags. When used as `tuiIconButton` don't forget to still put text label within the tag for accessibility.

name: ButtonX
description: A simple preset directive to configure a cleaner/close button, used in textfields, dialogs etc.

name: Calendar
description: A simple calendar. If you want a textfield with date, see InputDate and InputDateRange

name: Carousel
description: Generic swipeable container to scroll through content

name: Checkbox
description: A checkbox component that is able to imitate native control on mobile platforms. Use `--tui-background-accent-2` CSS variable to customize color of native control emulation

name: DataList
description: `DataList` allows to make lists or menus

name: DateFormat
description: Directive allows to customize `TuiInputDate` , `TuiInputDateRange` , `TuiInputDateMulti` and `TuiInputDateTime` date format.

name: Dialog
description: Customizable modal dialogs

name: Dropdown
description: `tuiDropdown` shows a dropdown with custom template. Use ActiveZone directive to hide dropdown. See also DropdownOpen

name: DropdownContext
description: `DropdownContext` allows to show custom right click context dropdown. To close dropdown: Use Esc Make mouse left/right click outside of dropdown content Manually toggle `tuiDropdown` to `false` using template reference variable (see first example)

name: DropdownHover
description: `DropdownHover` shows dropdown with custom template upon hover

name: DropdownOpen
description: `DropdownOpen` is a composite dropdown directive, similar to manual dropdown, but it also takes care of opening and closing on its own. If an element is a textfield ( `input` or `textarea` ), arrow down press opens a dropdown. The next press focuses the first item from the list. If it is not a textfield, click opens and closes a dropdown. By default directive is applied to the first focusable element inside. If you want another element to be the host, use `#tuiDropdownHost` reference. Use `tuiDropdownAuto` selector with no binding if you do not want to track open state

name: DropdownSelection
description: `DropdownSelection` shows dropdown with custom template on selected text

name: Error
description: Component for showing arbitrary messages styled as errors, with height and fade transition, as well as displaying form validation errors from controls

name: FilterByInput
description: Pipe for filtering an array by value entered in a textfield

name: Group
description: A directive for grouping other components. For example, Input or Button .

name: Hint
description: Directive to show a hint by hover of an element

name: HintDescribe
description: Directive to show a hint in accessible way upon keyboard focus

name: HintManual
description: Directive to show a hint manually

name: HintPointer
description: A directive to show a hint above the cursor

name: Icon
description: A component to show icons and color them with CSS. Taiga UI ships with Lucide icons . Same mechanism is used in all `iconStart` / `iconEnd` inputs across the library.

name: Input
description: Input is a basic string textfield. All other input components are built on its basis.

name: Label
description: Label is used to show text related to textfields, checkboxes, toggles and radio buttons

name: Link
description: Link component. It has focus highlight and can be customized with an icon Use `textContent` binding or wrapping entire content with a `span` to avoid extra whitespace introduced by browser to `a` tag when closing tag wraps to a new line — otherwise distance to the icons will be bigger than it should be

name: Notification
description: A notification message that can be displayed inline or as an alert

name: NumberFormat
description: Directive allows to customize `TuiInputNumber` , `TuiInputSlider` , `TuiInputRange` number format.

name: Radio
description: A radio component that is able to imitate native control on mobile platforms. Use `--tui-background-accent-2` CSS variable to customize color of native control emulation Due to internal Angular implementation of radio buttons, you are required to add `name` attribute to your `input` tag, unless you are using `formControlName`

name: Scrollbar
description: `Scrollbar` implements a custom scrollbar in Taiga UI style. Native scrollbar is hidden to keep native platform scroll experience Use `TUI_SCROLL_REF` token to get a scrollable container. For example, when working with virtual scroll.

name: Slider
description: Taiga UI styling of native html tag `'">` to choose a value from a limited range Read more about this input type in MDN Docs

name: Title
description: A directive for title with optional subtitle

name: CalendarExperimental
description: This is a work in progress The APIs might change in the future, use with caution

name: File
description: This component is based on Cell and therefore follows its rules on padding in horizontal mode. Reset `padding-inline` if you do not need it.

name: Popout
description: Using service to show content in a new window.

name: ScrollWheel
description: Work in progress, do not use! There are known issues in Safari, as always A component for spinning wheels or other infinitely scrollable containers, not to be confused with virtual scrolling which typically has ends.

name: ActionBar
description: It is an element on the bottom of screen to show actions by multiselect of some items. It works with custom content.

name: Badge
description: Component for displaying text, pictures and icons.

name: BadgedContent
description: BadgedContent is a wrapper for other components to add badges and notifications to them.

name: BadgeNotification
description: Simple non-interactive badge. Used in headers, cells, cards, avatars to indicate notifications, such as new messages

name: Block
description: `Block` is a special presentation of a checkbox/radiobutton which can display actual control or be a control itself

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Navigation element that shows a path from root page to the current

name: ButtonSelect
description: `ButtonSelect` is a form control for selecting one or multiple values, similar to a standard select element but with a button-based interface.

name: CalendarMonth
description: Month picker component. If you want a textfield, see InputMonth

name: CalendarRange
description: Component for choosing date range in calendar

name: Chip
description: Chip component is used to display array data and can also be interactive depending on the tag used.

name: ComboBox
description: `ComboBox` is a form control for selecting a single value from a set of options. It is similar to Select but with a major difference – possibility to enter value manually .

name: Confirm
description: Confirm is a ready to use Dialog to ask user to confirm an action See this example to learn how to use confirm to prevent data loss on forms inside other modals

name: Copy
description: This component provides an easy way to copy text content to the clipboard. It displays the content normally and shows a copy button on hover, with visual feedback when content is copied.

name: DataListWrapper
description: `DataListWrapper` is an abstraction over `DataList` to simplify usage in common cases where precise control is not necessary.

name: Emails
description: Pipe for creating autocomplete when entering email addresses

name: Fade
description: Directive that uses masking to fade out overflown content

name: Filter
description: Components shows separated items that can be used to filter content on the page. There are also an option with badges.

name: Flag
description: Pipe for getting source path to image with flag

name: FluidTypography
description: A directive that adjusts font size for the text to fit in the container

name: FormatNumber
description: Pipe to format number values to separate thousands Number formatting can be customized by using TUI_NUMBER_FORMAT

name: Highlight
description: Directive is used to highlight text in element. You can configure the directive with `TUI_HIGHLIGHT_OPTIONS` token. Allowed options: highlightColor: The default color for the highlight. Use function `tuiHighlightOptionsProvider` to provide new value of this token. Does not work with inline elements

name: InputChip
description: `InputChip` uses specifically modified Input to represent array of selectable items.

name: InputColor
description: `InputColor` = `Textfield` + `type="color"` + `Maskito` + ❤️

name: InputDate
description: `InputDate` = `Textfield` + `Calendar` + ❤️

name: InputDateMulti
description: `InputDateMulti` uses specifically modified InputChip to represent array of dates.

name: InputDateRange
description: `InputDateRange` = `Textfield` + `CalendarRange` + ❤️

name: InputDateTime
description: `InputDateTime` = `Textfield` + `Calendar` + ❤️

name: InputFiles
description: An input for uploading one or several files using native input file capabilities

name: InputInline
description: Inline input field

name: InputMonth
description: `InputMonth` = `Textfield` + `CalendarMonth` + ❤️

name: InputNumber
description: InputNumber is a form field to provide numerical input.

name: InputPhone
description: `InputPhone` allows to input a phone number

name: InputPhoneInternational
description: Allows to input phone number in international format `InputPhoneInternational` is based on @maskito/phone and libphonenumber-js libraries. libphonenumber is an ultimate phone number formatting and parsing library developed by Google . This library collects the latest phone number rules from ITU documents, user bug reports, telecom company home pages and government telecommunication authorities. It is always up-to-date (for more than 10 years), and releases are published almost every month. It means that `InputPhoneInternational` has the robust source of truth!

name: InputRange
description: `InputRange` = `Textfield` + `InputNumber` × 2 + `Range` + ❤️ 2

name: InputSlider
description: `InputSlider` = `Textfield` + `InputNumber` + `Slider` + ❤️

name: InputTime
description: `InputTime` allows users to enter and edit time values using a keyboard, dropdown or even browser native picker.

name: InputYear
description: Component to input a single year

name: ItemsWithMore
description: Component to hide overflown items behind custom content. Resize the screen to see extra items disappear

name: Like
description: A like component based on native checkbox with icons and custom color for icon when `:checked` state.

name: LineClamp
description: Component cuts overflown text with "..." and shows it by hover

name: Message
description: Message component is used to display message block.

name: Meter
description: Native styled Meter tag, using the same attributes as native version.

name: NotificationMiddle
description: A modal component to indicate an ongoing blocking action

name: Pagination
description: Pagination component enables the user to select a specific page from a range of pages

name: Pin
description: Pins are used to show a location on a 2D plane. Use `color` , `background` , `border` and `box-shadow` to customize the pin Pins are designed to be absolutely positioned on map or similar medium, therefore specifically their center is placed where you put them.

name: Present
description: `tuiPresent` allows to detect appearance of elements in DOM

name: Preview
description: Preview component allows to open modal for viewing some document and to work with it (download, zoom, rotate etc) As a document you can provide images, embeds and other arbitrary content. The component automatically adjusts to the mobile device

name: ProgressBar
description: `tuiProgressBar` – attribute component for native html tag `'">` . Usage: `'">` .

name: ProgressCircle
description: `'">` is a component to visually represent the completion of a process or operation (as a partially filled circle/ring). It shows how much has been completed and how much remains.

name: ProgressSegmented
description: `ProgressSegmented` is a component to visually represent the completion of a process or operation (as a segmented bar). It shows how much has been completed and how much remains. Actually, this component is the same `ProgressBar` processed by css-property `mask` .

name: Push
description: Notifications in style of native browser push

name: Range
description: A two-thumb slider for selecting a range of values

name: Segmented
description: Segmented is used for links and buttons to navigate within the application. It can also work as a radio button to toggle between different states.

name: Select
description: `Select` is a form control for selecting a single value from a set of options, similar to the native <select> element.

name: Sensitive
description: A directive that allows you to hide sensitive data under a pixel mask. This can be account balances, write-off amounts and any other content

name: Shimmer
description: `tuiShimmer` directive visually implements the "Shimmer" UI pattern — an animated loading indicator that simulates content appearance while data is being fetched. This pattern enhances the user experience by providing visual feedback during loading states, helping users understand that the interface is active and content is on its way. When to Use To indicate loading states in cards, headers, lists, avatars, and other UI elements. When you want to visually communicate that content is loading, rather than missing or frozen. Shimmer is used when you have cached data that is currently being refreshed and if you have no data at all — a better choice would be Skeleton

name: ShrinkWrap
description: A tight shrink wrapping implementation in modern browsers using progressive enhancement concept, see examples below for visual explanation. Requires scroll-driven animations to work, gracefully ignored in older browsers.

name: StringifyContent
description: Pipe that turns `TuiStringHandler` into content that works with `$implicit` .

name: Stringify
description: Pipe that creates `TuiStringHandler` by given key.

name: Switch
description: A switch component that is able to imitate native control on mobile platforms. Use `--tui-background-accent-2` CSS variable to customize color of native control emulation

name: Tabs
description: Component for creating tabs. If you use `routerLink` you must also add `routerLinkActive` directive.

name: Textarea
description: `Textarea` uses `Textfield` to create a multi-line string input.

name: Tiles
description: `Tiles` is a light-weight touch-friendly tiles grid drag and drop component with no predefined styles.

name: Timeline
description: An interactive timeline component for arranging events on a linear axis with no built-in styles

name: Tooltip
description: Component to show icons with a hint by hover

name: Tree
description: Component to display tree-like data structure

name: AppBar
description: Component for the main app header

name: BlockDetails
description: Layout directive for describing details. For example, transaction details

name: BlockStatus
description: Component for status screens, result screens and zero screens

name: CardMedium
description: A layout component used to create various cards for the interface. Define visual styles of the cards yourself or combine with Surface for visual presets. If you customize size, make sure to multiply by `--tui-font-scale` variable if you want to accommodate font scaling on mobile OS.

name: ElasticContainer
description: A wrapper component that changes its height with transition, depending on the content

name: FloatingContainer
description: `FloatingContainer` is a special container for creating different animated sticky footers

name: Navigation
description: Taiga UI is a low level component library with many atomic components that provide great flexibility when combined together. An exception to the general rule is the Navigation component – an opinionated global wrapping navigation that exposes less customization options developed specifically to target data-heavy dashboards with minimal space lost and compact controls.

name: PdfViewer
description: Wrapper component for viewing PDF files in an iframe PDF display in browsers is handled by each browser independently, using their own homegrown or 3rd-party code, as this is not part of the HTML spec. Keep in mind most mobile devices do not support displaying PDFs in iframe. Check it here . The only way to enforce rendering consistency in all browsers is to do the rendering server-side, bundle your own JS PDF renderer, or use a 3rd-party rendering service. If you want to display it yourself, so you need to rely on `WA_IS_MOBILE` token to provide suitable alternative behavior. For example, you can use third-party service `https://drive.google.com/viewerng/viewer?embedded=true&url=$YOUR_PUBLIC_PATH_TO_PDF` or your own service to render PDF by pdf.js.

name: Search
description: A wrapping component for search or filtering the table

name: Slides
description: A component for displaying dynamic content animated between states. Use negative value for `tuiSlides` to indicate backward direction, positive for forward direction and 0 for static crossfade. Important: each child must be exactly one DOM element.

name: Surface
description: General purpose container used in Taiga UI interfaces. Often used in conjunction with Card component.
